title: Adding latest power profile C37.237-2017 support.
description:
C37.238-2017: Parsing IEEE_C37_238 TLV for Power Profile 2017

The latest power profile C37.237-2017 has IEEE_C37_238 TLV differentfrom the 
earlier version C37.237-2011. The previous version of this standard, IEEE Std
C37.238-2011, separated grandmaster time inaccuracy and what was then called 
NetworkTimeInaccuracy into two fields. The first, grandmasterTimeInaccuracy, 
was located immediately before totalTimeInaccuracy in this version (now a    
reserved field). The second,networkTimeInaccuracy, was located where         
totalTimeInaccuracy is now found.
